description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing likes on comments within the OrangeHRM Buzz social module. It includes methods for listing likes, adding a like, and removing a like from a comment, implementing transaction handling and integrating with the core service layer.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for operations related to likes on comments in the Buzz module, including listing, creating, and deleting likes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of likes on a specific comment, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new like on a comment, handling transaction management and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a like from a comment, with validation and transaction management.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Helper method to set properties on the BuzzLikeOnComment entity before saving.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method parameters.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method parameters.
